source_batch.unit_label: BRBL C U05: Keep scheme funds, receipts and receipt-registration exceptions distinct

facts.statement: Section7 covers receipts to qualified buyers, separate scheme records/funds and trust arrangements;75% value holders under scheme may call meeting on non-realisation. Section8 exemption for undivided-interest receipts has immovable-right exception.

payload.title: A scheme balance is not a free corporate cash pool
payload.core_explanation_md:
The section 7 framework separates the money and realisations of the scheme for the qualified buyers interests, including the stated trust arrangement. A receipt evidences its defined interest; it is not a public deposit promise. Proper accounting must trace which scheme generated a collection and how it is applied rather than silently pooling it with unrelated schemes.

For the non-realisation situation described in section 7(3), the calling-meeting test uses holders representing not less than seventy-five per cent of the total receipt value under the scheme, not seventy-five per cent of investor headcount. Section 8 also needs care: the ordinary undivided-interest receipt exemption is not a blanket exemption for an instrument creating or extinguishing the specified immovable-property rights.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a receipt-registration exemption automatically cover an instrument creating a direct immovable-property right?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The stated exception must be checked.

payload.stem_md: A non-realisation meeting analysis uses the number of receipt holders and ignores their scheme receipt values. Which correction follows section 7(3)?

options.explanation_md: Employee numbers do not establish scheme receipt-holder voting value.
Branch count is unrelated to the prescribed holder-value threshold.

options.text_md: Apply the required receipt value under the relevant scheme
options.explanation_md: The statutory threshold is expressed in value, not holder headcount.

options.text_md: Combine every unrelated scheme to meet the number
options.explanation_md: The provision refers to the relevant scheme.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The statutory threshold is expressed in value, not holder headcount.

payload.stem_md: A receipt-related instrument is stipulated to create a direct right in immovable property. An officer applies the ordinary section 8 exemption without further review. What is missing?

options.text_md: The specified immovable-right exception to the receipt exemption
options.explanation_md: The exemption is not an unconditional rule for every receipt-related instrument.
An identifying number does not settle the exception.

options.text_md: A claim that all instruments are bank deposits
options.explanation_md: The financial interest and legal rights must be characterised correctly.

options.text_md: A rule allowing private wording to repeal registration law
options.explanation_md: Parties cannot enlarge a statutory exemption merely by relabelling a document.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The exemption is not an unconditional rule for every receipt-related instrument.
